query: SELECT a.id FROM whatsapp_linked_account a JOIN whatsapp_group_membership m ON m.account_id=a.id JOIN whatsapp_group_audience v ON v.binding_id=m.binding_id AND v.user_id=a.user_id JOIN comms_channel_participants cp ON cp.channel_id=$4 AND cp.user_id=a.user_id JOIN team_user tu ON tu.team_id=$5 AND tu.user_id=a.user_id WHERE a.id=$1 AND a.authorization_generation=$2 AND a.state IN ('connected','offline') AND m.binding_id=$3 AND m.authorization_generation=$2 AND m.consent_ended_at IS NULL AND m.remote_member AND m.reconciled AND v.revoked_at IS NULL AND v.remote_member AND v.reconciled AND cp.left_at IS NULL FOR SHARE OF a,m,v,cp,tu
